etymology.historical_story: Ozzy is a spelling variant of Ozzie, a familiar form associated with names such as Oswald and Osborn. Nicknames can also arise from surnames: the musician Ozzy Osbourne's nickname is an example. Consequently, the spelling alone does not establish a bearer's full name, ancestry, or intended name meaning. [Ozzy](https://www.behindthename.com/name/ozzy), [Ozzie](https://www.behindthename.com/name/ozzie)
